CustomField.description: When true, the formTemplate runtime exposes a Save Progress affordance so an authenticated user can persist a draft Form Submission and resume later. Hidden once the submission has a Submission Date (already submitted) or in read-only (disableAll) mode.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When enabled, a Save Progress button appears in the form so respondents can save and come back later. Their in-progress submission is committed with a status of Saved, and they resume exactly where they left off on their next visit.
CustomField.label: Allow Save Progress
